body.text: Run start 2026-11-19T00:57:02Z, as reported by status. The deployment uses one station plug and has no target rounds. I will register the supplied reconstruction unchanged and use its white-plug cycle to define the verification criteria.

components.name: camera
components.method: MoGe prior + known-geometry PnP profiles, background rotation and stationary-object camera anchors
components.note: Refined camera excludes partial-mask depth hump, max translation2.54cm. Focal regularized1050px; monocular sensitivity retained.

components.name: objects_6d
components.method: Blender geometry, SAM3/SAM2 and physically constrained render-and-compare
components.note: Watertight Blender models with white blade holes and correct socket forms; supported and physically airborne object motion, full-scene replayIoU .8774/.8069. Hidden poses invalid;10mm carry clearance inferred, absolute depth uncertain.

components.name: hand_motion
components.method: HaWoR plus mandatory MANO optimizer owned copy, all778 vertices, anatomical opposed contact and geometry-derived separation; independent installed validators
components.note: 360valid,handmaskIoU.8514; all10required checks pass; full-surface opposed-contact and support-halfspace refits, extra table check max0.426mm. Baseline and every non-default setting retained.

reprojection.note: against your own masks: agreement with them is necessary, not sufficient (3D errors along the viewing ray are invisible here)

anatomical_contact.note: a grasp needs the thumb and an opposing finger on opposite sides of the object; single-finger pushes or palm support are legitimate but must be stated in the analysis. Low penetration does not imply contact.

penetration_hand_object.note: unsigned (lower bound) distances where the object mesh is not watertight

self_penetration.note: triangle intersections between different fingers (FCL); counts are not volumes

physics.note: free-flight intervals are given with --flight OBJ=a:b; rest intervals default to object intervals without contact

handedness_scale.note: left/right are the demonstrator's anatomical hands; a hand is never mirrored

camera_focal.note: MoGe intrinsics are a learned prior; the focal should be calibrated against known geometry (camera_calib.py pnp). A large disagreement needs its explanation in NOTES.md (which one is wrong, and why).
